headline: Marketing ops to data analyst (B2B SaaS)

current.work: Builds weekly campaign performance reports in Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP) for the VP of Marketing, owns HubSpot data hygiene (dedupe, field standards, lead routing rules), and builds attribution dashboards she presents at monthly marketing reviews.
current.market: Bay Area, B2B SaaS (currently at a 400-employee company)
current.experience: 5 years in B2B marketing (2019-present): 2 years as Marketing Coordinator, then 2+ years as Marketing Operations Coordinator, individual contributor
strengths: Building reporting with Excel pivot tables and XLOOKUP
Building attribution dashboards and presenting results to leadership

target.work: Deeper querying and analysis (SQL) feeding BI/reporting dashboards, building on the reporting and attribution work she already does but with real query tools instead of pivot-table workarounds

goalInTheirWords: "I want to move into data analytics... I like the reporting/dashboard side already, just want to go deeper with real querying instead of pivot table gymnastics."
restatedGoal: Move from marketing operations coordinator to a data analyst role in B2B SaaS in the Bay Area, ready to start applying in about a year.
motivation: Enjoys the reporting/dashboard work she already does and wants to go deeper with real querying (SQL) instead of relying on pivot tables.
successLooksLike: Landing a data analyst role in B2B SaaS in the Bay Area, doing SQL-based reporting and analysis instead of pivot-table workarounds.
deadline: About a year from now (fall 2027) to start applying for data analyst roles
startingPoint: Strong Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), hands-on HubSpot reporting and data hygiene, and experience building/presenting attribution dashboards. No SQL or formal querying experience yet. Has tried a couple of free online courses before.
pastAttempts: Tried a couple of free online courses before but fizzled out around week three when work got busy.
